title: Vera offers real open times inside a conversation and books from it

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: when someone asks 'can I come in Thursday' in a DM or a contact form, the owner has to answer by hand. Calendly's assistant in email threads (Callie, beta) and Cal.com's phone agent do this. Frequency can do it inside its own messages and forms: Vera reads listOpenSlots, offers three times, and books the one the person taps, on the same validateAndPlaceBooking path. No reply goes out without the owner's switch on.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
